scope: Read-only review of twelve new strict decoder controls; no edits, compilation, tests, storage/ACL or native fixture review

findings.reason: The tested {0xff} bytes are invalid both for Snappy and for protobuf. Only asserting a nonnil error permits the ordinary fallback to fail at protobuf instead of propagating the original compression error.
findings.requestedBound: Require the actual compression error cause/boundary, or a verified invalid-Snappy and valid-protobuf contrast; do not broaden product behavior.

findings.reason: The positive helper verifies only no error and dynamic *pb.Change type; it does not check that the actual decoded snapshot/create/reset Fields remain nil.
findings.requestedBound: Assert actual original message equality or exact relevant nil Fields, retaining legitimate empty/reset semantics.

reviewedOtherBoundaries: Three malformed original protobuf Fields paths are constructed and encoded through real gogo protobuf, then passed to strict original decoder.
Empty snapshot/create IDs and absent original event are refused.
Unknown tag is tested through both strict refusal and unchanged ordinary admission.
Original plain and Snappy tags are exercised through actual encoding.
limits: No production regression was identified by this control-only review.
This is not the independent storage/ACL/whole-observer review.
